meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Acne-prone skin ke liye **meri first recommendation Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** hai—especially agar blackheads, whiteheads, oily skin ya active pimples hain. Iski price aam taur par ₹250–₹550 ke beech milti hai, lekin offers ke hisaab se badal sakti hai.[2][8]

**Budget ke andar options:**

- **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** — clogged pores aur active acne ke liye best; raat mein alternate days se shuru karein.[2][8]
- **The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Serum** — 2% salicylic acid + 5% niacinamide; acne ke saath oiliness aur acne marks ke liye, lagbhag ₹449.[2]
- **The Derma Co 10% Niacinamide Serum** — agar main problem acne marks, excess oil aur redness hai; lagbhag ₹187–₹222.[1][2]
- **Azelaic Acid 10% + Kojic Acid serum** — dark acne marks/pigmentation zyada ho, active pimples kam hon; lagbhag ₹587.[1]

**Kaise use karein:** face wash ke baad 2–3 drops, hafte mein 2–3 raat se start karein; moisturiser aur din mein SPF 30–50 sunscreen zaroor lagayein. Ek saath salicylic acid, retinol, vitamin C ya multiple acne serums na milayein—irritation ho sakti hai.[4]

Agar pimples deep, painful ya cyst-like hain, serum par depend na karein; dermatologist ko dikhana better hai.[4]
